notes.subject: to Jacob/Israel
notes.rationale: Direct rhetorical questions addressed to the people.

notes.subject: ואשוה
notes.rationale: Rare verb (shavah II 'be level/equal'): 'shall I be equal' vs 'be compared'; rendered as 'lamun ni a ye'.

notes.subject: Senumatigi
notes.rationale: קדוש is an adjective used as divine title, 'the Holy One'; Bamanankan needs a noun form.

translation: Ani min la aw bɛn ka ne ni a ɲɛfɔ ɲɔgɔn, ani ne bɛna lamun ni a ye? a ko, Senumatigi.
